story.title: The Klarpakke Story
story.p1: Six years ago, I lost 65,000 NOK on crypto. It was a brutal wake-up call. I blindly trusted "experts" who promised the moon but delivered nothing but fees and empty promises. Money drained away, and I was left with a costly but valuable lesson: Trust no one but yourself.
story.p2: Two years ago, I took control. I immersed myself in advanced programming and AI, developing my own auto-trader. I started small, tested, failed, and adjusted. As the algorithms began delivering consistent results, I gained the confidence to scale up.
story.p3: I quit betting, the lottery, and traditional savings accounts. All my focus went into the system. When the results exceeded my expectations, I started sharing the tool with friends and family. The response was overwhelming. It became clear that there was a need for an honest, transparent gateway to crypto for everyday people.
story.quote: In 2021, I lost money because I traded on emotions. I built Klarpakke to remove emotions from the equation. By using software to follow rules, and paper trading to prove skills first, we have removed the biggest traps for new traders.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To make advanced crypto trading accessible to everyone through education, transparency, and paper trading – so you can learn and practise without risking your hard-earned money.

pilotExplanation.title: How Pilot works
pilotExplanation.subtitle: Simple explanation — no jargon
pilotExplanation.step1Title: The bot buys and sells automatically
pilotExplanation.step1Desc: Think of it like placing nets at different price levels. Every time the price drops to a level, the bot buys a little. When the price rises again, it sells with a profit. You don't need to do anything — it happens automatically, around the clock.
pilotExplanation.step2Title: How does it know what to do?
pilotExplanation.step2Desc: We tested 32 different settings against 1 year of historical prices. The settings that gave the best results (without being overfitted) are now in use. Every week we test again with fresh data.
pilotExplanation.step3Desc: This is practice money — you cannot lose real money. The bot also has an automatic safety stop if the market drops sharply.
pilotExplanation.step4Desc: The bot checks prices every 5 minutes, around the clock. It buys when the price falls to one of our levels, and sells when it rises to the next level. You can see all trades in the history.
pilotExplanation.summary: In short: The bot buys low and sells high, automatically, with settings tested against 1 year of data. You can follow the results — everything is practice money, zero risk.

kursPilot.subtitle: Four short modules. Once you've finished them, you'll understand exactly what the Pilot does for you.
kursPilot.videoSoon: Video coming soon — the text below explains everything.
kursPilot.learnMore: Want to learn more? See all lessons →
kursPilot.mod1t1: Klarpakke is a training gym for crypto. You get 100,000 kroner in play money and trade at completely real market prices. You can never lose a real krone — but you learn everything you need.
kursPilot.mod1t2: All you need to start is an email address. No credit card, no ID verification. Press «Start the Pilot» inside the app, and it trades for you — explaining every step in plain language.
kursPilot.mod2t1: The Pilot uses a strategy called grid. Think of it as trading within a fence: when the price dips a little, the Pilot buys. When it rises back a little, it sells.
kursPilot.mod2t2: Small movements up and down become small gains along the way. You don't have to guess whether the price will moon or crash — the Pilot works with ordinary fluctuations, and tells you what it's doing.
kursPilot.mod3t1: Right now Klarpakke is in beta, and everything is play money. That's on purpose: you should get to practise as much as you want before real money is on the table.
kursPilot.mod3t2: When live trading opens after beta, you connect your own exchange account (OKX or Kraken) to Klarpakke. The money stays with you — we can never withdraw it. And you choose whether, and when, to go live. It's always your choice.
kursPilot.mod4t1: We'll say it straight: crypto can fall sharply in value. No one — not even a smart computer — can promise you profits. Those who do are lying.
kursPilot.mod4t2: That's why we have two golden rules: always practise with play money first. And if you one day go live: never use money you can't afford to lose. Ever.
kursPilot.ctaText: Then you're ready. Start with 100,000 kr in play money — and let the Pilot show you the rest.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know before starting

f1.q: Do I need prior knowledge of trading?
f1.a: No, you don't need any prior knowledge. Our courses start from basic concepts and build up gradually. Everything is explained clearly with practical examples. You learn step-by-step, from the most fundamental principles to advanced strategies.

f2.a: Paper trading means you trade with simulated capital (100,000 NOK) in a safe environment. You get to practice buying and selling crypto, setting stop-losses, and testing strategies without risking real money. It's like a flight simulator for trading — you learn without consequences.

f3.q: Can I get a refund if I'm not satisfied?
f3.a: No. You pay for access to our tools, not for results or promises of returns. Paper trading with 100 000 NOK in play money is free and unlimited. When you upgrade, you get immediate access to features like live trading, more strategies and advanced tools — like a software subscription.

f4.q: How long does it take to learn?
f4.a: Most people complete the basic course in 1-2 weeks by spending 30-60 minutes per day. You set your own pace. The course is available 24/7, so you can learn whenever it suits you best. Some take longer, others shorter — the important thing is that you learn thoroughly.

f5.q: Is this a shortcut to quick money?
f5.a: No, trading is a skill that requires learning, practice, and discipline. Our goal is to give you solid knowledge that makes you an informed and responsible trader. We focus on long-term learning, not unrealistic promises of quick money.

f6_vipps.q: What payment methods do you accept?
f6_vipps.a: We offer Vipps (Norway, Sweden, Denmark, and Finland), and payment via Stripe including Visa, Mastercard, and PayPal (as well as Apple Pay and Google Pay where Stripe supports it). Payments are encrypted; we do not store your card information.

f6_stripe.q: What payment methods do you accept?
f6_stripe.a: Payment is processed via Stripe including Visa, Mastercard, and PayPal (as well as Apple Pay and Google Pay where Stripe supports it). Payments are encrypted; we do not store your card information.

f7.a: Yes, the entire platform is mobile-optimized. You can take courses, do paper trades, and chat with the learning assistant from your phone. Learn anywhere, anytime.

f8.q: What if I have questions along the way?
f8.a: Our learning assistant is available anytime and answers in Norwegian. In addition, you have access to a community where you can ask questions and share experiences with other students. We also reply to emails within 24 hours.

f9.q: Do I have to use a specific broker?
f9.a: No, Klarpakke is completely independent. You choose which broker to use when you're ready to trade with real money. We give you the knowledge — you decide where to trade.

f10.q: What happens after I complete the course?
f10.a: You get a digital certificate confirming you completed the course. You keep access to all content forever, including future updates. You can also upgrade to higher plans for more advanced features when you're ready.

gapAnalysis.title: Trade Analysis
gapAnalysis.subtitle: Understand what affects your results
gapAnalysis.whatIsThisDesc: We continuously analyze every trade to ensure you get the best possible results. Here you can see what we check and what it means for you.

tca.title: Transaction Costs (TCA)
tca.shortDesc: How much does it cost to trade?
tca.fullDesc: We measure spread, slippage, and fees for every trade. The goal is to minimize hidden costs that eat into your returns.
tca.metricSpreadDesc: The difference between buy and sell price. Lower is better.
tca.metricSlippageDesc: The difference between expected and actual execution price. Occurs when the market moves before your order is filled.
tca.metricLatencyDesc: Time from signal to executed trade. Faster is better.
tca.alertDesc: You get an alert if slippage exceeds 20 basis points (0.2%) or costs exceed 0.5% of trade volume.

backtestGap.title: Backtest vs Live
backtestGap.fullDesc: We compare your live results with backtest data to see if the strategy performs as expected. A large deviation may mean the market has changed, or execution conditions are worse than simulated.
backtestGap.metricGapDesc: The difference between live return and backtest return in percent.
backtestGap.attribution: Where does the deviation come from?
backtestGap.attributionSlippage: Slippage: Order filled at a different price than expected.
backtestGap.attributionFees: Fees: Exchange fees are higher than in simulation.
backtestGap.attributionLatency: Latency: Delay between signal and trade.
backtestGap.attributionOther: Other: Market changes, liquidity, or strategy degradation.
backtestGap.alertDesc: You get an alert if deviation exceeds 20% for a strategy, or 10% on average.

fillRate.title: Fill Rate
fillRate.fullDesc: A 'partial fill' means only part of your order was executed. This can happen in volatile markets and costs you extra.
fillRate.metricFillRateDesc: Percentage of order that was filled. 100% is ideal.
fillRate.metricPartialDesc: Number of trades that were not completely filled.
fillRate.alertDesc: You get an alert if fill rate drops below 95%.

signalDecay.title: Signal Decay
signalDecay.shortDesc: How quickly does the signal degrade?
signalDecay.fullDesc: A trading signal is most valuable right after it occurs. The longer you wait to trade, the less valuable it becomes. We measure your accuracy based on how quickly you act.
signalDecay.bucketFastDesc: Lightning fast — signal is still fresh.
signalDecay.bucketMediumDesc: Good — signal still has high value.
signalDecay.alertDesc: You get an alert if your accuracy drops below 50% or if more than 30% of trades take over 2 seconds.

adverseSelection.title: Adverse Selection
adverseSelection.shortDesc: Are you trading on the wrong side?
adverseSelection.fullDesc: Adverse selection means you systematically trade the 'wrong way' — buying right before the price drops, or selling right before it rises. This may indicate other traders see information you don't.
adverseSelection.metricToxicDesc: 0-100 points. Higher means more trades went the 'wrong way'.
adverseSelection.metricAdverseDesc: Percentage of trades that went the wrong way.
adverseSelection.alertDesc: You get an alert if over 55% of trades show adverse selection.

plAttribution.title: P&L Breakdown
plAttribution.shortDesc: Where do your profits come from?
plAttribution.fullDesc: We break down your return into four parts: your own skill (alpha), market movements (beta), currency effects (NOK/USDT), and execution quality (fees + slippage).
plAttribution.metricAlphaDesc: Return from your strategy choices, independent of the market.
plAttribution.metricBetaDesc: Return you get simply for being invested in the market.
plAttribution.metricCurrencyDesc: How USDT/NOK rate changes affect your result.
plAttribution.metricExecutionDesc: Costs from fees and slippage. Negative means cost.
plAttribution.alertDesc: You get an alert if execution costs eat more than 1% of returns.

marketImpact.title: Market Impact
marketImpact.shortDesc: Do your trades move the market?
marketImpact.fullDesc: Very large positions can affect market price. We check if your trades are large enough to move the market.
marketImpact.metricRatioDesc: Your trade size divided by daily trading volume. Lower is better.
marketImpact.alertDesc: You get an alert if a trade exceeds 0.1% of daily volume.

metadata.title: Become a founder — free for life | Klarpakke
metadata.description: The first 100 to join as founders get free access to Klarpakke for life. No trial period. No fine print.

hero.title: The first 100 get free access for life.
hero.subtitle: Yes, you read that right. Not free for a trial period. Not «free for 14 days, then the invoice starts ticking». Free, as long as Klarpakke exists — if you are one of the first 100 to sign up as a founder.

notLottery.title: This is not a lottery ticket
notLottery.body: It is not a promise that you will get rich. It is an invitation to be part of something from the start that I have spent over half a year building.

whyFree.title: Why free for life?
whyFree.body: Because I need honest people, not just users.
whyFree.founders: The first 100 are called founders. You will test, tell us what is strange, what is good, and what must become simpler. That is worth more to me than money in the beginning.

whoAmI.title: Who am I, and why am I doing this
whoAmI.body: I work with technology and like to understand how things work under the surface. Since February 2025 I have taken a broad education in artificial intelligence, and since February this year I have used that knowledge to build Klarpakke.
whoAmI.team: I have not done it alone. A team of students from MIT and other schools has helped me brainstorm, test and analyse. We have discussed late into the night, laughed at bad ideas and been genuinely frustrated when something that «should just work» did not.

whatIs.title: What is Klarpakke
whatIs.body: Klarpakke is a simple Norwegian service for people who are curious about crypto, but do not want to spend their evenings on charts and jargon.
whatIs.simple: You should be able to press a button, get an explanation in plain Norwegian, and learn at your own pace.
whatIs.ai: We use artificial intelligence to follow the market and explain it more simply — not to promise miracles. AI can find patterns. It cannot see into the future, and it can never guarantee that you make money.

facts.title: Facts before fine words
facts.body: Crypto is full of big promises: «this robot never loses», «guaranteed profit», «last chance» — every Tuesday since 2021. Klarpakke will be different. We stick to facts, truth and numbers that can be proven:
items: We do not promise that you will get rich.
We do not hide when things go wrong.
We do not use numbers we cannot document.
We do not pretend a robot is always right.
facts.closing: If we cannot show it, we will not brag about it.

norwayFirst.title: Norway first, the world after
norwayFirst.body: Klarpakke starts in Norway, launching next Friday. The plan is to open for Europe and Asia in September. If you join now, you are in long before the rest of the world gets the chance.

benefits.title: What you get as a founder
items: Free access for life — not a trial period, no fine print.
The chance to practise with play money before you eventually use your own.
Direct influence on how Klarpakke develops.
A place in history before we open for Europe and Asia.
benefits.noKrypto: You do not need to know crypto. You do not need to be technical. You do not need to deposit a single krone.

warning.title: An honest warning
warning.body: This is a beta. There may be small bugs and short periods of downtime. Not because we are not trying, but because real people testing is the best quality assurance there is. When you tell us, Klarpakke gets better.

cta.title: Do you want to join?
cta.body: 100 places. Free for life. You are not too late — you are early.
cta.sub: Go to klarpakke.no — or write «JEG VIL PRØVE» in the comments, and I will send you a message.
